data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean, publication-ready SCI journal method figure in a crisp vector-like style, white background, wide landscape 1536x512. Topic: “Closed-Loop Differentiable System” for differentiable active-depth perception and quadrotor navigation.

Overall composition:
- Left-to-right timeline with three repeated time states: t, t+1, t+2.
- At each time state, show a compact closed-loop block chain from state node to rendering, perception, policy, camera update, dynamics, and next state.
- Use black arrows for forward rollout and red arrows for backward gradients.
- Small legend in upper-right corner with black arrow labeled “forward” and red arrow labeled “backward”.
- Clean, elegant, restrained, polished method schematic; rounded rectangles; subtle pastel fills; thin outlines; no 3D effects.

Color coding:
- Geometric rendering and perception: pale blue.
- Policy: pale green.
- Camera update: pale orange.
- UAV dynamics: pale purple.
- Gradients: red.
- White background.

Layout details:
- Place the first state node near left: “x_t, c_t”.
- For time t, show vertical stacked modules centered on the time lane:
  1) “R(x_t,E)” -> output label “D_raw,t”.
  2) “S_phi” -> input from D_raw,t, c_t, rho_t, x_t and output “D_obs,t, Q_t, M_t”.
  3) “Pi_theta = {Pi_f, Pi_c}” -> inputs “D_obs,t, s_t, c_t, m_t, h_t, q_t” and two outputs: “u_t” to dynamics and “c*_{t+1}” to camera update.
  4) “EMA” -> label “c_{t+1}=EMA(c_t,c*_{t+1})”.
  5) “f_dyn” -> label “x_{t+1}=f_dyn(x_t,u_t,Delta t_t)”.
  6) Output next state node: “x_{t+1}, c_{t+1}”.
- Repeat compactly for t+1 and t+2, with ellipsis indicating continuation. Keep the repeated time blocks compact so the figure fits elegantly.
- Show time badges above each repeated block: “t”, “t+1”, “t+2”.
- Show temporal iteration across the bottom or through arrows: x_t,c_t -> x_{t+1},c_{t+1} -> x_{t+2},c_{t+2}.

Loss nodes below timeline:
- Large rounded node under perception/policy area: “L_sens / L_teach” attached by black line to “Q_t, M_t” and the sensor block “S_phi”.
- Large rounded node under dynamics area: “L_flight” attached by black line to “x_{t+1}, u_t” and the dynamics block “f_dyn”.

Backward gradients:
- Use red arrows with arrowheads pointing backward.
- From “L_sens / L_teach” back to “S_phi” and to “c_t=[P,E,G]”.
- From “L_flight” back through “f_dyn”, “u_t”, “Pi_f”, “D_obs,t”, and “S_phi”.
- Show that gradients through “S_phi” reach the camera registers “c_t=[P,E,G]”. Add small red label near the gradient path: “dL/dc_t”.
- IMPORTANT: Do NOT show red gradients passing through R to scene geometry. R is forward-only and should only have black arrows.

Text labels to use exactly where possible and keep large/horizontal:
“x_t, c_t”
“R(x_t,E)”
“D_raw,t”
“S_phi”
“D_obs,t, Q_t, M_t”
“Pi_theta = {Pi_f, Pi_c}”
“u_t”
“c*_{t+1}”
“EMA”
“f_dyn”
“x_{t+1}, c_{t+1}”
“L_sens / L_teach”
“L_flight”
“dL/dc_t”
“forward”
“backward”

Style constraints:
- Scientific top-tier journal quality.
- Vector-like, crisp, elegant.
- Small recurrent/time badges, thin arrows, subtle pastel fills.
- No clutter, no drone icons, no watermark, no logo, no dark background, no perspective, no extra invented modules.
- Ensure all text is legible and horizontally oriented.
- Make the figure look like a polished paper method schematic, not a PowerPoint flowchart.

Accuracy constraints:
- S_phi is the differentiable perception module, not R.
- S_phi takes D_raw,t, c_t, rho_t, x_t and outputs D_obs,t, Q_t, M_t.
- Pi_theta contains both flight branch Pi_f and camera branch Pi_c.
- Pi_f outputs u_t.
- Pi_c outputs c*_{t+1}.
- EMA updates c_{t+1}.
- f_dyn updates x_{t+1}.
- Camera state is c_t=[P_t,E_t,G_t].
- Show temporal iteration x_t,c_t -> x_{t+1},c_{t+1} -> x_{t+2},c_{t+2}.
